relations.subject: n1ql:drop-index
relations.evidence: To drop a primary index, use the [DROP PRIMARY INDEX](dropprimaryindex.md) statement. For compatibility with legacy versions of Couchbase Server, you can also use DROP INDEX or DROP VECTOR INDEX to drop a named primary index.

cross_product_finding: Same access-model mismatch as createindex.json: this page's Prerequisites table keys the required privilege off 'cluster access credential type' (Basic -> Write, Advanced -> Query Index), not off a single named RBAC privilege like 'Query Manage Index'. Minted Capella-specific privilege/enum concepts rather than reusing privilege:query-manage-index. Additionally, the note 'For compatibility with legacy versions of Couchbase Server, you can also use DROP INDEX or DROP VECTOR INDEX to drop a named primary index' is another instance of server/-oriented legacy-compatibility language appearing verbatim on a Capella page, even though Capella (per this batch's framing) has no discrete versions of its own to be 'legacy' relative to - it only makes sense as a reference to the underlying Couchbase Server engine version lineage, not Capella's release model.
